description:
Show one procedure's contract and result notices linked by procedure_id.

Returns the latest formal award per lot (contractor, price, bid count, date, status).
Cancelled lots appear with status CANCELLED and no contractor.
compact=true returns notice summaries without descriptions, lots or repeated awards, and awards that name
their notice by number only and omit empty fields; call get_notice for a full notice.

compact.description: Return a smaller response: each notice once, no empty fields. Same awards and totals.
compact.title: Compact

number.description: Notice number as the source publishes it, e.g. "2026/BZP 00123456" or "123456-2026".
number.title: Number

source.description: Notice source: "BZP" (Polish Public Procurement Bulletin) or "TED" (EU Tenders Electronic Daily).
source.title: Source

name: procedure_results
title: Get awards for one procedure
